title: Azusawa Kohane — Sea Glass Full Of Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane!
Welcome back from the Seaside School!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna go ask my dad to see if I can take a break. Would you mind finding yourself an open seat in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you're back, I wanna hear all about your trip.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, sure!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you were in the same group as someone who does shows at Phoenix Wonderland?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! The younger sister of the person, Tsukasa, whom Aoyagi looks up to so much was there too. Her name's Saki.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know his sister went to Miya Girls!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She does. It was just surprise after surprise with our group.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki also knows the first friend I made in high school really well too, so we decided to have lunch together sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki's childhood friend was in our group too! They even said that they're in a band now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We even ended up talking a lot about singing and performing together at a show or an event in the future!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're in a band? That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And yeah, I bet it would be pretty fun to sing with them! I can't even begin to think how awesome it would be for us to all be on stage together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know, right?! Oh, but Saki also said that they're still just starting out, so they haven't performed in any events or anything yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They seem to really want to start playing for people and find ways to become as good as they can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So they're pretty serious about this, huh? I'm looking forward to working with them even more now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway... Day one of the Seaside School involved swimming, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki and I aren't particularly good swimmers, but Honami, Saki's friend and our groupmate, helped teach us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We also smashed watermelons, practiced our song for the last day, and made curry together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, you guys packed a lot of stuff into one day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that curry you made looked so good too! I really loved how you cut carrots into little stars and hearts! They looked so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we sort of decided to do that on the fly, but I'm glad we did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But Honami also looked really nervous the whole time since she knew Saki didn't have much cooking experience.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! She taught you two how to swim and was worried sick about her friend? Are you sure she's not her mom or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That thought crossed my mind too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, about your curry! I showed Akito and Toya that picture you sent me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I told them that you were enjoying yourself and Toya seemed genuinely glad that you were having fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Akito just scoffed at your picture and was like all, Whatever...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think he was turned off by all the decorative carrots you made for it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. He really doesn't like carrots, does he?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, did anything happen here while I was gone?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not much on my end.
I was busy the whole time helping out here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Akito and Toya ran into one of Akito's old friends and ended up doing a performance for the Summer Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think they were trying to mix in a dance routine for a change too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? I wish I was there to see it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure you will soon! I heard that they practiced a ton with Len to get it down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They said that they want to show us in SEKAI sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's great! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me neither! Not only that, we'll be able to get back to our usual routine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know it's only been a few days, but each day felt so long since we weren't really practicing like normal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... I felt the same way...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We practiced singing our song for the last day a lot and I even practiced some on my own, but all of it just made me want to return to being Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It really made me realize how lucky I am to have teammates like you, Akito and Toya.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right back at you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot...! I got a little ahead of myself talking about what I did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: These fish-shaped oshikura-manju are for you and your dad, An! And this is for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Hey, can I open it now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sure...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope she likes it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a photo frame...!
Wait, are these pieces of sea glass? They're gorgeous...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My group managed to find some on the very last day of the Seaside School.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We found enough to try and make a sort of mosaic of them for some photo frames.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, hold on! You're saying that you made this yourself, Kohane?! I totally thought that this was store-bought!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can really have this?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! I hope you get a chance to use it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
I promise to cherish it and find a good picture to put in it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But which one would be best...?
Oh, that one with us in front of the cherry tree might work!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. I'm so glad that she likes it. It was worth the effort.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll have to make sure to give Shinonome and Aoyagi their gifts too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you make photo frames for them too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, these seemed a little too girly for them, so I brought back some snacks for them instead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm giving them the same fish-shaped oshikura-manju that I gave you and your dad just now. Apparently, where we stayed is really famous for them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I don't blame you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm sort of wondering how they'd react if you gave them the photo frame you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope I see them soon. I'm really looking forward to giving them their gifts.)
